name: Seed
storyline: In the 21st century technology surged as planet earth faced ruin. We at Seed Industries terraformed the planet Avesta in the Tau Ceti System. Seedlings are the next step in human evolution. Now we're opening The Eilo Archipelago, a new continent to settle.You, as a Cultivator, have one goal: to ensure your Seedlings live out their best possible lives - whatever that may be. Choose your society, work together with other players, and continue humanity's legacy in this new world! Life is precious, take care of it, and create something even more valuable - a lasting legacy.
summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.
